params.effort: 0..1 the knob pointer turns from LOW (0) to MAX (1); five detents at 0, .25, .5, .75, 1; the yellow arc lights up to the pointer
params.think: 0..1 token tiles stack up in the cage, 14 at 1 (one tile is 1/14); 1/7 = 2 tiles
params.out: 0..1 the answer card slides out of the printer slot
params.ok: 0..1 the card strip and the lamp turn green
params.bad: 0..1 the card strip and the lamp turn red and the card's number bars vanish (no answer)
